statement: Fear is a subject in 3 of 16 books with three different handlings: Brave Bora names it and a parent supports him; Bohlale names it herself and defuses it by looking again; Good Night, Monu shows it only in pictures and the child settles it alone.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books: Book Dash (13), African Storybook (2), StoryWeaver/Pratham Books (1); 2014-2025

analyst_note: 2026-10-15: Bohlale (African Storybook): scary eyes 4/5, about 2 on the engine's 0-3 scale, defused on the next page. Monu (StoryWeaver): 4/5 over three pages, about 2 on 0-3. In neither does an adult support the child at the fear peak.

magicpaper.current: fear, panic, grief, despair (intensity 3) never permitted at age 5-6
magicpaper.suggested: Open question, not a recommendation: whether named fear followed by adult support could be allowed mid-story. One book cannot answer it.
